lines.t: The room was blue with unspoken ache
Dust in the light and a heart that broke
I wore my silence like borrowed skin And the night kept pulling me in
Then a whisper moved through the storm Not loud, but wholly warm
Like dawn touching shattered glass You came to me at last
Yahushua, you are the breath in the hollow
The light that I reach for when I can't follow
You turn my ruins into rain
You speak my name through all my pain
Yahushua, my wild and sacred song
When I am weak, you make me strong
I was lost, but now I see
You were always reaching for me
I fell apart when I saw you
Like a moon that forgets the night
Your mercy spilled through every crack
And pain in my shadows white
I was a field of broken thorns Waiting for the seed of grace
Then your love came soft and sure And made a garden from my waste
Now I'm standing where the hurt gives way Where the dead things learn to sway
And every scar becomes a door To the one my soul adores
Yahushua, you are the breath in the hollow
The light that I reach for when I can't follow
You turn my ruins into rain
You speak my name through all my pain
Yahushua, my wild and sacred song
When I am weak, you make me strong
I was lost, but now I see
You were always reaching for me
Lay my pride down in the dust
Teach my restless heart to trust
If the night is all I know
Still your fire will make me glow
Let the veil be torn in two
Let my every breath be you
I am less and you are more
Forever and evermore
Yahushua
My thunder soft, my morning blue
Yahushua, everything I am belongs to You
